notes: {"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.0 — Community Hub tab refused to load on every install because RSI started returning null for the per-post account.live flag in their SSR payload. Thanks @WhisperDark for the report and screenshot."],"features":["Community Hub: zod schema for followedPostsFromSSR[].account.live now accepts null and coerces it to false at the extraction boundary. The whole tab (Home + Live + Discover + Gameplay + Tutorial + Events) was failing the parse because of this single field, even though Live was the only strip that actually consumed it."]}

{"info":["Spectrum got a complete overhaul — you can now read forums and DMs, vote, react, subscribe, bookmark, and navigate notifications without ever leaving the popup. Plus a critical Firefox / Waterfox fix that resurrected message passing between the popup and the background worker — every action was silently hanging on FF-MV2 since 1.2.x."],"features":["Spectrum — Forums tab: full browse tree (community switcher → channel groups → threads → thread detail with nested replies). Works for SC and every org community you've joined. Hot / New / Top / Active sort buttons all return results now (three of the four were sending the wrong wire vocabulary and silently returning empty).","Spectrum — Reading: thread bodies render with rich text (bold / italic / mentions / links), inline custom community emojis, media preview thumbnails on cards, and the official CIG gold tint on staff posts. Replies show member org / role badges next to the author name.","Spectrum — Vote: ▲ button on every thread and reply. Click to upvote, click again to remove your vote. Pressed state shows when you've voted.","Spectrum — React: full emoji picker on every thread, reply, AND DM message. Resolves both the per-community custom emojis (with image media) and ~250 standard Slack-style shortcodes (face_palm, clown_face, fire, etc.) including country flags via :fr: / :us: / :flag-jp: form. Click an existing chip to toggle your own reaction.","Spectrum — Subscribe: bell button on the channel header (watch every new thread) and on the thread detail (watch every new reply). Notifications fire to the popup's badge once activity hits.","Spectrum — Bookmarks: the thread detail's star button works, and you can now bookmark an entire forum channel from its header. Click any item in the Bookmarks tab to drill into it inside the popup.","Spectrum — Notifications: click a notif to mark it read AND navigate straight to the thread / lobby it points to (in-popup, no new tab). Hover-revealed × button dismisses individual notifs; the existing Mark all read sweeps the rest.","Spectrum — DMs: read-only chat history with 30s auto-poll, member badges, custom emoji rendering, and the same react / picker UX as forums.","Spectrum — In-popup navigation: clicking a card in DevTracker / Trending / Bookmarks / Notifications now drills into Forums or DMs inside the popup instead of opening a new RSI tab. Ctrl/Cmd/Shift/middle-click still opens externally for users who want a browser tab.","Spectrum — Forum search: ⌘K-style search box across thread titles in the current channel.","Community Hub: new Home tab with four strips — Live streams, Trending, Gameplay, Tutorial — so you don't have to flip through tabs to scan what's new.","Firefox MV2: popup → background sendMessage was returning undefined immediately on Firefox because chrome.runtime.sendMessage there isn't reliably Promise-native. Switched to browser.runtime.sendMessage when the namespace is available — every Spectrum / notify / module-fetch action now works on FF / Waterfox / LibreWolf instead of throwing 'No response from background worker'.","Notify poll: stopped spamming three RsiNotAuthenticatedError warnings per tick when the rsi_token cookie was still present locally but the server had already invalidated the session. The error was technically real but cosmetic — the next identity refresh corrects state, no value in shouting about it three times.","Org badges in Spectrum: badge icon URLs come back from the API as relative paths (/media/...). Now absolutified once at the extraction boundary so org logos actually render in the popup instead of broken-image glyphs.","Bookmarks: switched from the v2 endpoint (which required CSRF priming and could fail when no RSI tab was open) to the legacy v1 path. No user-visible change except: bookmark add / remove now works regardless of whether you have robertsspaceindustries.com open elsewhere."]}

{"info":["Tiny hotfix on top of v1.2.1 fixing a 404 on every Community Hub post link."],"features":["Community Hub: clicking a post in the Discover / Gameplay / Tutorial tabs no longer 404s. RSI collapsed the per-user post routes during their late-2025 hub rework, so /community-hub/user/{nickname}/post/{slug} stopped resolving in favour of /community-hub/post/{slug}-{uid}. The Live and Events tabs were already on the new format and were unaffected."]}

{"info":["Maintenance hotfix on top of v1.2.0 — three small but visible fixes from the first week of reports."],"features":["Firefox / Waterfox: fixed a crash in the toolbar-badge code that prevented unread counts (Comm-Link, Patch Notes, Status alerts) from updating on Firefox-MV2 builds. The popup itself was unaffected — only the numeric badge on the extension icon. Thanks @ravensrook for the report.","Patch Notes: removed the LIVE / PTU / EPTU / TECH-PREVIEW channel filter. CIG only publishes LIVE patches as Comm-Links these days so the other three tabs were permanently empty and confusing. Channel detection still runs per-card so the coloured badges keep telling you what kind of build each note covers. Thanks Dakota for the heads-up.","Release Notes module: fixed the date displayed next to each v1.x entry — six versions had stale placeholder timestamps stuck in the future (v1.2.0 was showing 3 May when it actually shipped 25 Apr). All entries now use the real git-tag dates."]}

{"info":["User-experience round driven by the post-1.1.x community feedback — popup is now resizable, the Settings module reorganised into three tabs, and a brand-new Support module collects bug-report flows, FAQ, and links in one place. Plus a quiet but important fix that finally surfaces every legacy referral and subscriber pledge in your Owned ships list."],"features":["Settings → Appearance → Popup size: two sliders to pick the popup window dimensions between 360×400 and 790×590, applied on slider release so the popup doesn't reflow under your cursor mid-drag. Defaults to the previous 760×520, and there's a Reset button.","Settings → Appearance → UI scale: ±/Reset controls that wrap your browser's native per-tab zoom (Ctrl + / Ctrl − / Ctrl-scroll) for tab mode, with browser-managed per-site persistence. The section is disabled in popup mode with a one-click shortcut to open the extension in a tab.","Tab mode: the sidebar now breathes more — wider rail, larger icons, more spacing between modules. Popup mode is unchanged because it has to fit 14 modules in a tight height budget.","Settings module reorganised into three top-level tabs (Appearance, Performance, Diagnostics) so you stop scrolling past unrelated cards to find the one you want.","New Support module in the sidebar: GitHub repo + pre-filled bug-report URL + Discord invite, clipboard shortcuts for Discord templates and hangar dumps, FAQ covering the questions most users ask, and an About card with the version and links to the privacy policy + Release Notes.","Ships: legacy referral and subscriber pledges that have no product-type tag on RSI's side (e.g. \"Surf and Turf\" containing a PTV, \"Gladius and Gold\" containing an F7A Hornet Mk II) now scrape correctly. Your Owned count finally matches what's in the RSI hangar end-to-end.","Ships: legacy pledges missing from RSI's CCU catalogue (rare older items) are now correctly marked as Owned in the Ships grid based on the hangar match alone, instead of being silently hidden when CCU didn't list them.","Roadmap: more empty / zombie release entries filtered out (cosmetic carry-over from the 1.1.1 work)."]}

{"info":["Quick follow-up to v1.1.1 closing three more hangar-detection bugs reported within an hour of release — thanks @DAVosselman for the debug dumps."],"features":["Ships: legacy pledges with no server-side product-type classification are now scanned properly. This was the last gap — some older referral-ladder rewards and subscriber bundles (e.g. 'Surf and Turf' containing a PTV, 'Gladius and Gold' containing an F7A Hornet Mk II) only appeared under the 'All' view of the RSI hangar and were silently dropped by the v1.1.1 scraper. Your Owned count should now match what the RSI website shows.","Ships: alias added for 'Genesis Starliner' — the matrix only calls it 'Genesis' so the exact-name lookup was failing.","Ships: stray trailing whitespace on RSI matrix names (observed on the C8X Pisces Expedition entry) no longer defeats name matching."]}

{"info":["Maintenance release with targeted fixes from the first round of community feedback on v1.1.0 — thanks to @DAVosselman, @DeusMaximus, Etyx and Kamille for the reports."],"features":["Ships module: ships included in game-package pledges are now detected — previously the hangar scraper skipped any package whose first item happened to be an Insurance or Digital Download row, silently hiding every ship the package contained. If your owned count looks bigger than before, that's why.","Ships module: the 'Copy hangar dump' button in the header copies a Markdown snapshot of your hangar (matched + unknown) to the clipboard — makes it trivial to report detection issues without typing every row by hand.","Ships module: paints, components, multi-tools, tractor beams, subscriber flair and similar non-ship pledge items no longer appear as 'unknown ships'. The hangar scrape now filters server-side by product type, so only standalone-ship and game-package pledges are ever considered.","Ships module: ground vehicles tagged as 'Vehicle' in the hangar are accepted alongside those tagged 'Ship', fixing some older PTV / Cyclone pledges that were silently dropped.","Roadmap module: patches that are live on the game (4.4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.7 and onward) now correctly appear under 'Released' instead of 'Upcoming'. RSI's public roadmap API had been returning a lying 'released: 0' flag on those — we now trust the 'status' string like the official site does.","Roadmap module: zombie entries with zero cards no longer clutter the Upcoming list (the duplicate 3.8 slot was the obvious case)."]}

{"info":["Two new features — both carry-overs from the v2 extension that we brought back by popular demand — plus the bug fixes from v1.0.2 (which only reached the Firefox store)."],"features":["Organizations: each org member row now has a UserPlus button to send a contact request with one click — no more copy-pasting handles into the search box","Contacts → Sync to PTU: one-click workflow that mirrors your LIVE friend list onto your PTU account. PTU's social graph is a separate database from LIVE and never auto-syncs, so testers who switch to PTU would otherwise start with an empty contact list every wave","Spectrum now handles channels with a null color — before the fix, those channels crashed the entire identify response and broke every signed-in module for some community configurations","Background script is now compatible with older Firefox-based browsers (Waterfox, older ESRs) that predate Firefox 114's auto-promisified chrome.* APIs — the extension stopped flooding the console with storage errors on those engines"]}

{"info":["Maintenance release with two user-facing fixes on top of v1.0.0. Published on Firefox only — Chrome and Edge users skipped 1.0.2 and will get the same fixes as part of 1.1.0."],"features":["Fixed Spectrum / signed-in features for users enrolled in communities beyond Star Citizen proper — some channels with a null color were breaking the whole identify response (GH #25)","Fixed the background script flooding the console with errors on Firefox-based browsers that predate Firefox 114's auto-promisified chrome.* APIs (Waterfox was the original report — thanks Etyx)"]}

{"info":["First stable release (1.0.0) after years of 0.x pre-release versions. Complete rebuild of the extension with a new stack and Firefox support. Legacy 0.1.x / 0.2.x notes are included below for reference."],"features":["Fresh redesign — Firefox now supported alongside Chrome and Edge","Pledge Store: browse ships, paints, gear, game packages, packs, merch, add-ons, event tickets, gift cards and UEC — with live prices","Shopping cart: add, remove and clear items directly from the extension; one-click jump to checkout on RSI","CCU Upgrade tool: find cross-chassis upgrade routes from your owned ships with real-time pricing","Ship detail pages built-in — specs, components, variants, editions and prices without leaving the extension","Galactapedia reader — full articles with inline links, categories with thumbnails, featured picks and a random-article button","Settings module — clear cache, customize the sidebar, toggle prefetch, export a debug bundle for bug reports","Full-screen tab mode — open the extension in a browser tab with a responsive layout","Favorites — star your ships and Galactapedia articles for quicker access","RSI Status pill in the header — server health at a glance, with context on error banners","Comm-Link full search — channel, series, type filters and sort options like on the official site","Progress Tracker — roadmap cards grouped by category for a quick look at what CIG is working on","Community Hub — Live, Events, Discover, Gameplay and Tutorial feeds","Organizations — dedicated Membership, Invitations and Applications tabs","Referral Program visible in the header and Dashboard, with recruits and prospects","Faster — most modules render instantly on repeat opens","Error-resilient — a crashing module no longer locks the whole popup; reload just that module","Roadmap with change highlights — cards marked as new, moved or removed since your last visit","Keyboard shortcuts — Ctrl/Cmd+K to focus search, Alt+1..9 to jump between modules, Esc to dismiss"]}
